notes: §1985:VIII.4.5.2 prints two formats for a relative file: Format 1 READ file-name-1 [NEXT] RECORD [INTO identifier-1] [AT END ...] [NOT AT END ...] [END-READ], and Format 2 READ file-name-1 RECORD [INTO identifier-1] [INVALID KEY ...] [NOT INVALID KEY ...] [END-READ], with no KEY IS phrase. The one superset rule readStatement keeps the printed order of NEXT, RECORD and INTO (INTO before RECORD and a second INTO are COBOL2269, a literal after INTO a syntax error); Associates keeps the two phrase pairs apart (INVALID KEY beside AT END or beside NEXT, a repeated phrase and ON EXCEPTION are refused); BindRead with CheckReadRandomAccessPhrases and CheckReadKeyFormat holds each pair to its access mode (COBOL1720) and CheckReadKeyOrganization refuses KEY IS on a relative file (COBOL0864). The later editions' additions are refused at 85, each COBOL0900: PREVIOUS (VisitReadDirection), WITH LOCK, IGNORING LOCK and ADVANCING ON LOCK (VisitRecordLockPhrase, VisitReadIgnoringLock, VisitReadAdvancingOnLock) and RETRY (VisitRetryPhrase). All of that was probed at --std 85. What is not implemented is the printed sequence inside each phrase pair: the conditionalPhrases loop and Associates have no edition arm for the order, so NOT AT END before AT END and NOT INVALID KEY before INVALID KEY compile and run at 85; either order is the 2002 change (§2002:F.2 item 33). The same mechanism was recorded for the relative DELETE and the indexed formats. A dynamic-access READ with AT END and no NEXT also compiles; that is §1985:VIII.4.5.3 SR3's row and kb/Work PB5102's, not this format's. The witness runs Format 1 with and without NEXT and RECORD and Format 2 with and without INTO, all in the printed order.

next.reason: 1985 relative READ: Format 1 READ f [NEXT] RECORD [INTO] [AT END][NOT AT END], Format 2 READ f RECORD [INTO] [INVALID KEY][NOT INVALID KEY], each pair in fixed order. §2023:14.9.30.2 adds PREVIOUS, ADVANCING ON LOCK, IGNORING LOCK, retry-phrase, WITH [NO] LOCK and puts the AT END/INVALID KEY pairs in choice indicators (either order); §2023:14.9.30.3 SR9 implies NEXT in dynamic mode when AT END is written, where 1985 SR3 required NEXT. The KEY phrase is not new for relative files (§2023:14.9.30.3 SR10 'only if ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED'). More forms accepted; 1985 forms keep their meaning. CHANGED (looser).
